name: strata-copilot-chat
description: Use models running in Strata (local, OpenAI-compatible API) inside GitHub Copilot Chat, like LM Studio. Supports text, tool calling and image input. Known issue: if Strata is closed and reopened, Copilot Chat may not rediscover the provider until the 'Strata (local)' integration is disabled and enabled again, or the Strata model is refreshed with the Strata: Refresh Models command.

strata.baseUrl.description: Base URL of the Strata OpenAI-compatible API (the 'API base URL' shown in the Strata app).

strata.apiKey.description: Optional API key. Leave empty when Strata has no key configured.

strata.maxOutputTokens.description: Maximum tokens Strata may generate per reply.

strata.contextWindow.description: Context window (in tokens) reported to Copilot Chat for Strata models.
